scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @assistflow/shared && npm run build --workspace @assistflow/server && npm run build --workspace assistflow-widget && npm run build --workspace assistflow-workstation && npm run build --workspace assistflow-demo
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace @assistflow/shared && npm run build --workspace @assistflow/server
scripts.start:demo: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others -n server,demo -c green,yellow "node --experimental-sqlite --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning apps/server/dist/main.js" "npm run preview --workspace assistflow-demo"
scripts.predev:all: npm run build --workspace @assistflow/shared && npm run build --workspace assistflow-widget && npm run build --workspace assistflow-workstation
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n shared,server,widget,workstation,demo -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @assistflow/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @assistflow/server" "npm run dev --workspace assistflow-widget" "npm run dev --workspace assistflow-workstation" "npm run dev --workspace assistflow-demo"
